title: Manufacturing Technician I, MD Fill - B2 Shift
location: Waco, TX, US
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
This is our  MD Fill - Aseptic Gown -  B2 night shift:  6pm-6:30am Wednesday - Friday & every other Saturday
Performs functions associated with cGMP manufacturing operations within the biologics production facility, including working with engineers in set-up and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components and final materials. Uses sophisticated programs (such as LIMS, SAP, automated control systems, etc.) to collect and evaluate operating data, which can be used to conduct on-line adjustments to products, instruments or equipment. Determines and may assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process.
Responsibilities
Must have the ability to become aseptic gown certified.
Shipping finished materials.
Maintaining inventory levels.
Sampling of in process and raw materials.
Running glass washer / autoclave.
Buffer / media preparation.
Equipment preparation (CIP / SIP).
Cell culture (from vial thaw to production scale).
Column chromatography.
Tangential flow filtration
Wear an aseptic gown during an 8 hr shift. This gown covers the full body.
Willing to complete a lot cleaning sanitation during the work shift
Follow all clean room entry and exit procedures
Wear the required aseptic gowning and PPE correctly at all times
Perform hand hygiene and sanitization before entering the clean room
Maintain aseptic technique to prevent contamination of materials and products
Sanitize work surfaces, tools, and equipment on a frequent and consistent basis
Minimize movement, talking, and unnecessary activity in the clean room
Inspect gowning and PPE for proper fit and integrity before use
Report any contamination concerns, spills, or equipment issues immediately
Handle sterile materials only in approved areas and in a controlled manner
Follow all environmental monitoring and cleaning requirements
Dispose of waste and contaminated materials according to procedure
Complete all required documentation accurately and on time. Good hand writing will be a huge plus.

title: Launch Program Manager II, Global Engineering Services (GES) Launch
location: Austin, Texas, USA
description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, the Global Engineering Services Launch Team needs talented, bright, innovative and driven leaders. The key to this mission is strategic, large scale project management initiatives that will allow us to scale our organization for the future in an extraordinary manner. The Launch team is seeking a qualified candidate to solve the complex challenges of progressive innovation to drive efficiencies at operational benchmark rates. We are looking for a customer-obsessed Program Manager with proven program management experience and a strong track record of delivering results to own and execute highly strategic launches, in addition to driving multiple complex projects across one or more programs. If you are looking for an environment where you can drive business innovation amidst various levels of ambiguity, this is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing team within Amazon!
As a Launch Program Manager, you will work with and influence numerous cross-functional stakeholders both inside and outside of Global Engineering Services (GES) with a direct impact to our internal customers in operations. This role calls for an individual who is proficient in continuous improvement and is experienced in strategically developing processes and mechanisms to achieve business goals.
This role requires up to 75% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.
Key job responsibilities
• Gain trust and consistently deliver results
• Work backwards from the customer to scope and define program requirements and critical milestones
• Navigate ambiguous situations without heavily relying on direct support from their leader
• Demonstrate a high level of ownership to drive multiple time sensitive actions items simultaneously through multiple business groups
• Manage multiple projects with competing deadlines whilst maintaining a customer focus
• Collaborate and influence team members, work with development teams and other business groups, and present projects to senior leadership on a regular basis
• Partner to build and execute on new initiatives and roadmaps each year
• Optimize cross-team processes that improve team efficacy and delivery
• Take ownership and accountability for programs, while maintaining the ability to ask for help, and escalate issues and problems as necessary to keep programs on track
• Problem solve with a high degree of ambiguity and operating in a rapidly evolving and changing landscape
• Dive into the details and leverage high judgment and gut instinct
• Communicate effectively to all stakeholders related to a launch or program/project
• This role requires extensive travel, up to 75%.
A day in the life
• Managing the Road to Launch process, which ultimately allows for a building hand-off that passes operational readiness testing and sets the operations team up for success
• Managing day-to-day relationships with multiple site types under the GES Launch Team scope
• Coordinating GES and Operations stakeholders to exceed Amazon standards for the launch of new sites or expansions of existing buildings in order to achieve operational success
• Deep diving existing processes to identify defects or opportunities for process improvements
• Compiling, managing, and reporting on weekly project metrics
• Driving multiple projects to optimize, standardize, and/or improve processes within and outside of launch

title: Sr. Program Manager, Worldwide Ergonomics and Safety Experience Team
location: Arlington, Virginia, USA
description:
Amazon is looking for an enthusiastic Sr. Program Manager to join the Workplace Health and Safety (WHS), Translations, Education, and Development (TED) team. We are not an average company, and this is certainly not your average position. This role offers you the opportunity to revolutionize safety training delivery worldwide. TED seeks an experienced, self-motivated Program Manager who excels in a fast-paced environment and has a solid background in program management. This role will support the deployment and management of safety training programs for operations associates and leadership globally.
As a Sr. Program Manager, you will work across teams to collaborate, generate buy-in, develop and execute to a plan. You will drive the expansion and growth of our global safety training programs, scaling globally. You will play a crucial role in devising strategies, fostering partnerships, and executing initiatives to enhance the program's reach and impact. This entails serving as the main point of contact for stakeholders in coordinating and managing strategic, cross-functional, and business-critical programs and projects. The ideal candidate excels in crafting large-scale global training program strategies, encompassing training design, roadmaps, gap analyses, financial planning, communication, and launch plans in a dynamic and diverse business environment. Effective communication and program management skills are essential, enabling you to manage multiple competing priorities and coordinate work across teams. The successful candidate will be proficient at working with data to identify trends, identify improvement opportunities, and proactively define plans to realize these opportunities. To be successful in this role, the candidate will effectively multitask and prioritize, utilize data to encourage decisions, and maintain a high level of independence. They will be comfortable working in a growing and ambiguous work environment as we constantly improve and innovate. This leader must have solid written and verbal communications skills, the ability to influence stakeholders, and willingness to dive deep into details.
Key job responsibilities
• Accountable for the overall program strategy and planning for their regions/business units, communicate program requirements, negotiate priorities, and define success metrics.
• Apply project management best practices to drive plan execution, mitigate risks, and improve effectiveness to deliver results in a timely manner.
• Continuously improve program components and mechanisms to drive results and provide program status communication, deliver clear and concise summaries to leadership teams and effectively answer questions.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for coordinating and managing strategic, cross-functional, and business-critical training programs and projects.
• Build partnerships with key stakeholders and organizations to promote training program adoption.
• Effectively communicate and manage multiple, competing priorities while coordinating work across teams.
• Define, track, and monitor progress against success metrics and project plans. Analyze and report on overall project health using key performance indicators and success metrics, and accurately and clearly report on status against program objectives
Key job responsibilities
- Define and manage the lifecycle of cross-functional programs, including setting the mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria that keep delivery on track.
- Drive alignment across internal and external stakeholders by facilitating clear decision-making, managing expectations, and communicating progress and outcomes to senior leadership.
- Analyze data and metrics to identify risks, surface opportunities for improvement, and ensure programs remain aligned with broader organizational goals.
- Partner with engineering, product, and business teams to prioritize initiatives, make informed trade-offs between time, effort, and deliverables, and remove blockers that slow progress.
- Evaluate opportunities to integrate generative artificial intelligence tools into program workflows, refining outputs and applying responsible practices to improve productivity and quality.
A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing program dashboards and metrics, identifying areas that need attention before your first stakeholder sync. Mid-morning, you facilitate a cross-team working session to align on priorities for an upcoming milestone. After lunch, you draft a narrative document summarizing trade-offs for a director review, then connect with an engineering team to unblock a dependency. Throughout the day, you move fluidly between strategic planning and tactical problem-solving, keeping multiple workstreams progressing toward clear goals.

location: United States, Multiple Locations, Multiple Locations
description:
Overview
Are you excited about Microsoft Azure? Join our team as a Cloud Solution Architect - Cloud & AI Infrastructure ! We work with customers to help them achieve their business priorities and guide them in their Cloud & AI transformation journey. We also support customers in evaluating their applications and business requirements, recommend solutions that meet their requirements, and demonstrate these solutions to win technical decisions.
We’re looking for a Cloud Solution Architect to help customers migrate, modernize and secure their infrastructure, applications, and data on Microsoft Azure, laying the foundation for scalable, production-ready AI solutions. As part of the Cloud & AI Infrastructure team, you’ll deliver engagements focused on migration, modernization, operational excellence and resilient architecture using frameworks like Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Framework (WAF). You’ll work closely with customer IT leaders to design and implement scalable solutions, resolve blockers, and accelerate adoption of Azure services through repeatable IP and delivery excellence. With deep expertise across Azure infrastructure, applications, databases, SAP, and hybrid environments, you’ll play a key role in helping customers unlock the full value of their Microsoft Azure investments.
We are currently looking for passionate, collaborative  Cloud Solution Architect - Cloud & AI Infrastructure  professionals to join our teams across various business groups, for varying customer sizes, in our enterprise, regulated, and partner services organizations. By applying to this role, you will be considered for multiple opportunities within Microsoft across the United States including locations beyond where the role is posted. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home. Travel percentages will vary according to role.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Create business value by translating customer challenges into actionable solutions aligned to high ROI customer outcomes. Ensure a seamless, connected experience that fosters satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term value.
Lead architectural design sessions and deliver secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure solutions aligned to customer business goals using frameworks like CAF and WAF.
Partner with technical and sales teams to identify opportunities and develop tailored solutions to drive expansion and business value realization.
Drive migration and modernization initiatives, including committed proof of concept and production milestones, across infrastructure, data, SAP, and AI workloads.
Ensure customer environments are optimized for health, resiliency, security, and performance—enabling production-scale AI use cases.
Deliver repeatable IP and contribute to centralized IP development to accelerate deployment and achieve targeted outcomes.
Identify and resolve technical blockers to accelerate go-live and ensure delivery excellence.
Generate incremental pipeline from each engagement by driving next best actions and aligning with business priorities.
Maintain technical intensity through continuous skilling and certifications in priority workloads such as Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, AKS, App Service, AVS, SAP (Native + RISE), Windows, Linux and Defender for Cloud.
Engage in technical communities, share best practices, and contribute to knowledge reuse to accelerate customer transformation and success.
Embody our  culture  and  values

Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 2+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.

description:
Overview
Are you curious, enthusiastic about infrastructure, and ready to solve complex challenges in the AI era? Join us as a  Solution Engineer - Cloud & AI Infrastructure   focused on the Azure Platform for commercial customers at Microsoft. In this technical sales role, you will help customers design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures that support their modernization goals. Using Azure’s IaaS and PaaS services, you will guide organizations through migration, modernization, optimization, and innovation—translating technical capabilities into significant business outcomes. You will also collaborate across teams to deliver impactful solutions that enhance agility, reduce costs, and unlock value through AI-powered infrastructure.
As a  Solution Engineer - Cloud & AI Infrastructure,  you will play a key role in helping customers modernize their infrastructure and unlock the full value of Microsoft’s cloud. You will work directly with technical and business stakeholders to design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient architectures that support AI workloads and business-critical applications. You will bring deep expertise in migrating core workloads—including Windows, SQL Server, Linux, PostgreSQL, and Oracle—to Azure.
Beyond migration, you'll lead customers through modernization using the 6R strategy, containerization best practices, and Azure-native services like AKS and Arc, while exploring how AI and intelligent agents can accelerate legacy transformation.  You will also apply strong networking knowledge to design hybrid and cloud-native solutions, including virtual networks, VPNs, and secure routing architectures that meet enterprise performance and compliance needs. You complement this with trusted partner solutions like NetApp, VMware, RedHat, and SAP to ensure a secure, optimized, and scalable migration experience.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Drive technical sales by using technical demos, proofs of concept, and technical architecture accelerators to influence solution design and enable deployments.
Lead architecture sessions and technical workshops to accelerate Azure adoption.
Build trusted relationships with platforms leads to co-design secure, scalable solutions.
Resolve technical blockers by collaborating with engineering and sharing customer insights.
Maintain expertise in cloud migration (Windows, SQL, Linux, PostgreSQL, app workloads), resiliency, security, and compliance.

Represent Microsoft in customer forums and technical communities through thought leadership.
Embody our  culture  and  values

title: Senior Manager, Engineering Program Management
location: San Francisco - SF9
description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role
Samsara's Sr. Manager, Engineering Program Management leads the hardware EPM team that takes new devices from concept through mass production and general availability. You will own the launch system for the hardware portfolio: the development process, the OK2 gate reviews, the xVT build plan, and the single cross-functional schedule from investigation through PVT and GA. Your team partners daily with EE, PD, Firmware, Full Stack, Reliability, Compliance, Product Management, Operations Program Management, Supply Chain, and our JDM partners in Taiwan and China.
This is a player-coach role. You will hire, develop, and lead a team of Engineering Program Managers across the US and Taiwan, and you will personally drive our most complex or highest-risk program when the business needs it. You report to the VP of Hardware Engineering.
Hardware Engineering at Samsara runs a leveraged model: a lean internal team paired with JDM partners and AI tooling rather than headcount. We expect this leader to treat AI as a core part of how the EPM discipline operates, not an add-on. You will set the standard for how program managers use AI agents and automation to run programs, and you will be measured on the adoption and results that follow.
This is a hybrid position open to candidates residing in the US who are willing to work in our San Francisco, CA office three days a week. This position requires travel up to 25% of the time, including international travel to Taiwan and China, and proximity to an international airport. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
You should apply if
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.
In this role, you will
Lead the EPM team
Hire, develop, and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high-performing team of Engineering Program Managers in the US and Taiwan. Set clear expectations against the TPM/EPM leveling framework and coach each EPM to the next level.
Assign EPMs to programs based on complexity and risk, rebalance as the portfolio shifts, and step in personally to drive the most complex or highest-risk program when needed.
Build the recruiting pipeline, interview loop, and onboarding plan that let the team scale without lowering the bar.
Own the hardware launch system
Own the end-to-end hardware development process from investigation and concept through EVT, DVT, PVT, and GA, and tailor it per program so small programs stay light and large programs stay controlled.
Run the OK2 gate reviews (OK2Concept through OK2FCS) with the VP of Hardware Engineering and Hardware Product Management, and hold the organization to the entry and exit criteria for each gate.
Own the integrated program schedule across HW, FW, SW, reliability, compliance, and supply chain, including the xVT build plan, build allocations, and JDM deliverables through PVT.
Set the standard for program status, risk, and decision communication to executives, and run the weekly hardware project review and steering forums.
Deliver programs
Deliver new hardware programs on schedule, at target cost, and at target quality. Make performance, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs explicit in every status update and gate decision.
Manage JDM and CM partner engagement across the development phases, from RFQ through PVT handoff to Operations Program Management.
Partner with Product Management, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Compliance, and Finance so that program goals, business cases, and launch commitments stay aligned as programs evolve.
Identify ways to shorten time to market, improve first-pass build yields, and reduce development cost, and drive those improvements across the portfolio rather than one program at a time.
Make AI how the team works
Use AI tools daily to synthesize program data across Slack, Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, and meeting transcripts; to draft status, risk, and decision documents; and to analyze schedule, cost, and quality data. Validate AI output critically before it reaches stakeholders. You own the result, not the model.
Own adoption and results of AI tooling across the EPM discipline, including the hardware EPM agent that drafts meeting notes, action items, status reports, Confluence updates, and schedule changes for EPM review. Own its roadmap and extend it into risk detection, schedule analysis, and build readiness.
Design, deploy, and iterate AI agents, skills, and automations that remove manual coordination work from program management. Treat AI as a productivity lever before headcount, quantify the hours removed, and reinvest that time into risk management and technical depth.
Set the baseline AI fluency expectation for every EPM on the team, coach to it, and include it in performance and development conversations. Share patterns, prompts, and agent designs across Hardware Engineering and the wider R&D program management community.
Report AI adoption and outcomes (usage, hours saved, cycle-time or quality improvements) to Hardware Engineering leadership on a regular cadence.
Champion Samsara's culture
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's Operating Principles as we scale globally and across new offices.
Minimum requirements for the role
12+ years of experience shipping high-volume hardware programs at scale with ODM and JDM partners overseas, taking products from concept through mass production.
4+ years of experience managing and developing engineering program managers, including hiring, performance management, and coaching across levels.
Proven ownership of a hardware product development process (phase gates, xVT builds, design reviews, PVT handoff) and the judgment to standardize it where it helps and tailor it where it does not.
Strong engineering background with the ability to understand and challenge trade-offs across electrical, mechanical, firmware, reliability, manufacturability, schedule, and cost.
Demonstrated hands-on use of AI tools in your own program management work, and at least one example of an AI workflow, agent, or automation you designed and deployed for a team.
Executive communication skills: concise written and verbal status, risk, and decision communication to VP and C-level stakeholders.
Expertise with program planning tools (Smartsheet or Microsoft Project), Jira and Confluence, and PLM systems for BOM and ECO management.
Ability to travel internationally up to 25% of the time.
BS in a relevant technical field such as EE, ME, or CS, or equivalent experience.
An ideal candidate also has
Worked as an EE, ME, or firmware individual contributor on hardware programs before moving into program management.
Shipped dash cameras, telematics gateways, asset trackers, or other ruggedized, cellular-connected IoT devices with embedded AI/ML.
Built or led an AI agent, Cursor skill, or automation program adopted by a team beyond your own, with measured results.
Led distributed teams across the US and Taiwan or China, and worked directly with Taiwan-based JDM design centers and factories.
Experience bringing firmware and hardware development onto a single integrated schedule, including OTA readiness at launch.
MS in a technical field or an MBA.
